text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I notice El Condor Pasa sitting in the
cafeteria
with a big grin on her face
during lunch break.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Oh, hey, Trainer. I just got a package
from my
family!
choice_data_list: いいことでもあったのか？
いいことでもあったの？

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
My family's secret recipe hot sauce! One

spoonful's enough to get you soarin'!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
It'll spice your meal up for an energy
eruption!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
That's why I went ahead and got twice as
much
food as usual.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
No doubt I'll be winnin' back to back if I
eat
plenty of this!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
You think so? If it'll make me stronger, I
don't
think there's any better way.
choice_data_list: 一気に使い切るのはもったいない
いっぱい食べて、強くなろう！

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Hmmm... You mean, like, important
races?
choice_data_list: ここぞという時まで取っておこう

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
I see... So if I eat it all right before a big
race, I'll
be able to run in peak
condition!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Good thinking! That's why you're my
trainer! To
think I almost ate it all in one
sitting...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Agh! But I already ordered all this food!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Oh, gracias! Okay, then let's hold on to
this hot
sauce till the time is right...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
And have lunch together! Food is extra
delicious
when you share it with
someone else!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Sí! You don't need to tell me twice,
Trainer!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Time to eat up and get strong!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Curry, fried rice, omelet rice! I'll dye it
all red and
turn it all into power!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
El Condor Pasa drenches all the food she
ordered
with hot sauce and makes quick
work of it.
